units: Dated events and approximate named-place coordinates in longitude/latitude degrees
note: Original paraphrases linked to institutional histories and primary documents. Markers locate cities or regions, not territorial extent, exact ceremonies or front lines. Years are conventional historical years; dates before 1582 follow the historical Julian calendar unless noted.

items.title: Regensburg
items.text: The 1803 Final Recess reorganised the empire, secularising ecclesiastical territories and mediatising many imperial cities. Regensburg locates its institutional setting.

items.title: Vienna
items.text: Francis assumed the title of Emperor of Austria in 1804, while still holding the older imperial office.

items.title: Rhine Confederation
items.text: The formation of a separate union of Rhenish states was cited in Francis’s declaration ending his imperial office. This regional anchor is not a boundary or treaty-signing site.

items.title: Vienna
items.text: On 6 August 1806 Francis II laid down the imperial crown and released imperial estates and servants from their obligations.
